mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, bu.nickname as nickname, u.nickname as username, su.type, su.visible FROM system_users u INNER JOIN system_store_user su ON su.user_id = u.id and su.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN system_business_user bu ON bu.user_id = u.id and bu.deleted = b'0' and bu.business_id = su.business_id WHERE u.deleted = b'0'
and u.status = 0
AND (bu.nickname like concat('%', #{pageReqVO.nickname}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{pageReqVO.nickname}, '%'))
AND su.store_id = #{pageReqVO.storeId}
order by su.type desc,u.create_time desc
